name: Acqua Gardens Penthouse
description:
Discover a refined lifestyle in this exceptional newly built penthouse located in the charming and increasingly sought-after area of Cancelada, Marbella. Designed with modern living in mind, this elegant property combines space, comfort, and style, making it an ideal choice for families, groups, or anyone looking to enjoy the best of the Costa del Sol in a peaceful yet well-connected setting.

The penthouse offers four beautifully appointed bedrooms, each filled with natural light and designed to provide a relaxing and comfortable atmosphere. The two contemporary bathrooms feature high-quality finishes and a clean, modern aesthetic. At the heart of the home, a spacious open-plan living area creates a welcoming environment where the living room, dining space, and kitchen flow effortlessly together. Large windows enhance the sense of space and brightness, while the seamless connection to the outdoor area allows you to fully enjoy the Mediterranean climate.

Set within a secure and well-maintained gated community, the property offers residents access to excellent shared amenities, including a swimming pool and a fully equipped gym. The surroundings are მშვიდ and private, providing a sense of exclusivity while still being close to everything you need.

One of the standout features of this penthouse is its unbeatable location. You are just a short walk away from a variety of local restaurants, cafés, and a supermarket, making everyday living incredibly convenient. Within a short 10-minute drive, you can reach the vibrant marina of Puerto Banús, known for its luxury boutiques, fine dining, and lively atmosphere. The beautiful beaches of Marbella and several renowned golf courses are also just minutes away, allowing you to fully embrace the coastal lifestyle.

Whether you are looking for a stylish holiday retreat or a comfortable long-term residence, this penthouse offers the perfect combination of modern design, prime location, and high-quality living in one of Marbella’s most desirable areas.

Please note that we welcome families and couples only, no groups under 30, and no hen or stag parties. Should you fall outside of this category but wish to book nonetheless, please send us an enquiry detailing a bit more about yourself and the group that you will be travelling with so we can request this for you.
